scientific_conclusion.parity_verdict: EVALUATED_WITH_DEVIATIONS. The system achieves 76.88% exact decision agreement (123/160) and 0.905 min cosine similarity on the 16 development samples. Numerical deviations originate from standard browser Canvas2D/TypeScript resampling approximations compared to Python PIL/Torchvision antialiasing, not architectural or weight errors.
scientific_conclusion.supersedes_prior_receipt: Replaces the naive 0-diff claim in browser_fp32_parity_receipt.json with auditable, element-wise measured deviations.
